meta_description: Intelligent document processing wired into the process: confidence-gated extraction, provable posting, captured corrections and a queue that shrinks on a signed monthly curve.

blocks.x: Extraction and adjudication inside the process, not beside it: documents become decisions with confidence gates, per-field evidence and a human queue that shrinks by design — because the root causes of the queue are fixed, not just staffed.
The queue is the product — and it is measured like one
blocks.sub: Age bands, root causes and the shrinkage discipline that closes the backlog

blocks.x: IDP inside hyperautomation is different from standalone extraction: the output is not a spreadsheet, it is a process decision — an invoice matched, a claim registered, a contract clause routed. That means confidence gates tuned per field class, adjudication queues that feed the process, and evidence that satisfies the audit two years later.

The measure of success is the human queue, and it must shrink on measurement: straight-through rate climbs as the adjudicated eval set grows, and every correction a reviewer makes becomes training signal under version control.
Below: the failure modes that keep document queues eternal, the architecture that wires adjudication into the process, and the console that shows the queue shrinking by root cause.
Unrouted confidence to unowned aging — why document queues stay eternal
blocks.sub: Unrouted confidence, unproven posting, uncaptured corrections, unowned aging

blocks.x: Each of these survives a pilot and bankrupts the operation at scale — the countermeasures target root causes so the queue shrinks instead of being staffed.

widgets.title: Document path — click each stage for its contract

stages.name: Ingest
stages.detail: Mail, portal uploads, EDI and scans land with provenance stamped; channel metadata drives preprocessing (deskew, DPI normalization) before any model sees pixels.

stages.name: Classify
stages.detail: Document family first, then layout-registry match; unknown layouts quarantine with a low-cost strategy while the registry learns.

stages.name: Extract
stages.detail: Field-level extraction with confidence calibrated per field class; totals get arithmetic cross-checks (line items must sum) before acceptance logic.

stages.name: Verify
stages.detail: Vendor master match, PO match, arithmetic identity, duplicate detection — the checks that catch what confidence cannot see.

stages.name: Review
stages.detail: Uncertain fields routed with highlights and candidates; corrections typed back with provenance and flow into the next training round.

stages.name: Write
stages.detail: SAP/ERP postings carry idempotency keys and reconciliation totals; a replayed batch corrects rather than duplicates.

widgets.note: Verification catches about 3% of documents that confidence alone would have waved through — arithmetic does not hallucinate.

blocks.x: Money-path documents carry mandatory dual review above signed value thresholds — automation stops there by design, and the stop is logged as a control, not a failure.
The confidence gate is the product
blocks.sub: Route-don't-guess adjudication — and why correction capture is the compounding asset

blocks.x: Document processing programs fail by optimizing extraction accuracy while ignoring the routing decision that actually protects the money path. The gate is the product: every extracted field carries a confidence score, and the gate routes on the score band — high confidence posts straight through after reconciliation, mid band goes to a human queue with the uncertain fields highlighted, low band goes back for recapture. The bands are set per document class from the risk matrix, because an invoice under $200 and a change order under $2M do not share a tolerance. Reconciliation against source — three-way match for PO flows, ledger match for accruals — runs before posting, so the queue measures exceptions, not errors.

Correction capture is the compounding asset. Every human fix is recorded as a labeled correction bound to the page region and the field, and the correction stream feeds the monthly gate recalibration — which is why straight-through share climbs for months after go-live instead of decaying. The queue itself is managed as a product: age bands, root-cause tags and a monthly shrinkage review that kills the worst extraction failure class each cycle, rather than a support inbox that quietly grows.

items: Route, do not guess
Confidence bands set per class from the risk matrix; nothing posts uncertain.
Reconcile before post
Three-way match on PO flows, ledger match on accruals — exceptions, not errors.
Correction capture
Every fix bound to page region and field; feeds monthly gate recalibration.
Queue as a product
Age bands, root-cause tags and a monthly shrinkage review with owners.
What happens when extraction confidence is low?

The gate routes by confidence band: high posts automatically with page-level evidence, mid goes to review with fields pre-annotated, low routes to a human with the reason attached. The gate never silently guesses.
Can you prove what was posted matches the document?
Every posted record links to its source page and field-level evidence. Maker-checker runs on the money path, and the audit extract reconstructs any posting end to end.
Does this work with our scanners, portals and EDI feeds?
Yes — capture channels are typed inputs feeding one adjudication flow, and the systems of record receive typed, gated output rather than raw extractions.
How do human corrections make the system better?
Every correction is captured with its reason and feeds band calibration. Correction velocity is a console metric, and the monthly review kills the worst failure class each cycle.
How long until the queue actually shrinks?
The chart is the commitment: root-cause review from month one and straight-through targets signed per month. The month-6 band is the contract, not the aspiration.
